about.title: Meet Dimitri
paragraphs: Dimitri's Auto Service is a state-of-the-art shop on McLoughlin Blvd. Dimitri explains what's going on in plain terms, uses high quality parts, and is known for finding problems other shops miss.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Dimitri will get back to you. Or call (503) 305-8534 (Mon–Fri: 9am–5pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Dimitri will get back to you soon to set up a time.

services.name: Diagnostics
services.blurb: Check engine lights and hard-to-find problems.
services.intro: Warning lights, strange noises and problems that come and go, tracked down to the real cause so you only pay for the repair you need.
photos: Scan tool plugged into a car

services.name: Timing Belts
services.blurb: Timing belts and water pumps, done on schedule.
services.intro: A timing belt is cheap insurance compared to the engine damage a failed one can cause.
photos: Mechanic working on an engine with a wrench

services.name: Heating & Cooling
services.intro: No heat in the truck or an engine running hot? We fix thermostats, heater problems and cooling systems.
photos: Mechanic reaching into an engine bay

services.name: Starters & Batteries
services.intro: Car won't start, battery keeps dying or something electrical acting up? We track it down.

services.name: Maintenance & Oil Changes
services.blurb: Oil changes, filters, fluids and scheduled service.
services.intro: Regular maintenance keeps your car running right and catches small problems before they turn into big ones.
